options.C: Version control can be understood differently depending on the project, but its core purpose remains useful.
options.D: Learning what job version control performs is a good first step for a beginner.

items.explanation: B is incorrect. Version control is a system for tracking and coordinating changes. The other statements do not redefine version control as a programming language or remove the need for responsible engineering.
